Introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Project boards often need to be filtered, sorted, and grouped just right, and rebuilding that setup every time wastes effort. Now you can save any configuration as a view and return to it instantly, whether it's a filtered backlog, a sprint board grouped by assignee, or a timeline sorted by due date.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep dedicated setups for every project, client, or workflow without losing track of them. Views can also be shared with your team, giving everyone the same filtered perspective without needing to recreate it themselves, which is especially useful for standups, planning sessions, and onboarding new teammates.

Saved Views works across all your existing lists and boards, with no setup required beyond saving your first view. Give it a try on your busiest project first, and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
